_comment: Rules that derive a card's `provides` tags from its oracle text and type line.
A tag is added when either regex matches; both are matched case-insensitively
against lower-cased text, so write the patterns in lower case.
These are the Reality Fracture (FRA) rules from DEC-925. Copy this file to
<set-dir>/tags.json and rewrite the rules for the set you are grading:
a tag only earns its place when some card's grade depends on counting it.
The `needs` value in grades_src.py must name a tag that exists here.

rules.note: cards that put loyalty on the Jace token, plus real planeswalkers
turns on the common dual lands, which enter untapped only with a planeswalker
